page.introTitle: This table holds two kinds of rows
page.introBody: The “Default track” tier is the commission track every individual owner enters through — it is not for sale, cannot be retired, and there is only one. The other tiers are shop plans sold by vehicle count and term. “Retire” only blocks NEW purchases; running subscriptions keep the price and limits they locked in until the term ends.

form.packageIntroBody: Zero platform fee per trip. The shop picks a tier matching its fleet size, pays up front by term, and unlocks the full management toolset.
form.commissionIntroBody: The entry track for every individual owner: nothing paid up front; the platform takes a % of each trip through the hold the customer pays when booking.
form.commissionPercentHelp: Calculated on the total trip value the customer pays.
form.commissionCustomerSideNote: Owners still receive the full rental amount. The platform fee is added to what the customer pays — it is not deducted from the owner's side.
